ArtifactHead.description:
Durable CAS-updated pointer to the active version of one logical artifact.

Version rows in artifact_versions.jsonl remain immutable and auditable;
this head only states which version is current for consumers such as the
Reviewer, so old versions are never lost.
ArtifactHead.title: ArtifactHead

ArtifactVersion.description: Immutable content-addressable version of one logical artifact.
ArtifactVersion.title: ArtifactVersion

ControlRequestKind.description: Durable user-issued control intent consumed at a safe execution boundary.
ControlRequestKind.title: ControlRequestKind

DataContract.description: Small deterministic boundary contract; no runtime JSON-schema dependency.
DataContract.title: DataContract

ForkDirective.description: Immutable user-issued intent to roll a project back to a work item.
ForkDirective.title: ForkDirective

ForkMode.description: How a user-issued rollback should behave.
ForkMode.title: ForkMode

PlanBranch.description:
Append-only snapshot of one user-issued rollback branch.

Status transitions append new snapshots; ``read_branches`` returns the
latest snapshot per branch id so the branch history stays auditable.
PlanBranch.title: PlanBranch

RepairRequest.description: Immutable assessment-triggered request evaluated by deterministic policy.
RepairRequest.title: RepairRequest

ResearchPlanRevision.description: Append-only execution overlay; never a free-form replacement plan.
ResearchPlanRevision.title: ResearchPlanRevision

ResearchProjectControl.description:
Current control intent for one durable project.

The request itself is also recorded as an append-only project event; this
file is only the latest intent that the runtime consumes at the next safe
work-item boundary (or immediately when no execution holds the lock).
ResearchProjectControl.title: ResearchProjectControl

workflow_template.description: Executable workflow template id (workflows/*.yaml); None keeps the legacy hard-coded workflow.
workflow_template.title: Workflow Template

workflow_template_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the frozen workflow template source file.
workflow_template_sha256.title: Workflow Template Sha256

ReviewTarget.description: Immutable set of artifact/result digests that a Reviewer may assess.
ReviewTarget.title: ReviewTarget

WorkAttempt.description: Immutable attempt record for one work-item execution.
WorkAttempt.title: WorkAttempt

WorkItemHead.description:
Durable CAS-updated pointer to the committed result of one work item.

The head is authoritative: the working result.json is only a mirror of
the immutable attempt snapshot it references, so recovery never guesses
business state from Trace events. Replaying the same committed attempt is
an idempotent no-op.
WorkItemHead.title: WorkItemHead

WorkerLease.description: CAS-bound claim that one worker may execute one work item attempt.
WorkerLease.title: WorkerLease
